profile.headline: Software Engineer at Salesforce Pardot
profile.summary: Graduate of Georgia Institute of Technology, lover of Continuous Integration, and firm believer in Dependency Injection.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Migrated careerbuilder.com Ruby search API to use Google Cloud Job Discovery V2.
• Replaced legacy SOLR feeding infrastructure with NodeJS service deployed to AWS ECS.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: As a team, created a myriad of Dockerized Golang services as a part of modernizing the legacy ATS application. Initially deployed these applications to a legacy CoreOS cluster, but later migrated to a new AWS ECS cluster with greater stability and performance.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for retrofitting a legacy PHP application with a modern Node.js browser testing framework.
      • Designed to adhere to the Page Object Model:
         https://martinfowler.com/bliki/PageObject.html
      • Facilitated the modernization of the legacy application by detecting errors
         during the testing pipeline while major changes were made to the application.

Designed and implemented a Continuous Integration pipeline for CareerBuilder ATS product.
      • Automatically runs all Unit/Selenium/Integration tests for all Pull Requests,
         requiring checks to pass before code can be merged.
      • For production-ready code, tests are run and a single, deployable artifact
         is generated. Helped to minimize the time required during deployment and
         greatly reduce the probability of errors occurring.
      • Eventually Dockerized the entire CI pipeline. Allowed swapping between
         CircleCI and other CI platforms with minimal effort.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Responsible for creating a simulator for the UGA Artificial Intelligence lab's new quadcopter test platform. Created a control mechanism allowing the physical quadcopter to communicate 			with the computer environment.
